description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Source mapping: Page Task 2 Lock ZAQ contracts and compatibility.

**Files:** propose new `lib/zaq/channels/file_requirements.ex`, `lib/zaq/channels/delivery_plan.ex` with nested Step, and later `lib/zaq/channels/delivery_executor.ex`. Extend `lib/zaq/channels/bridge.ex`, `lib/zaq/channels/delivery_error.ex`, and `lib/zaq/engine/messages/outgoing.ex` minimally.

**Work:** finalize unresolved/not-applicable limit semantics, transfer modes, step/result contracts, normalized certainty, and private plan handling. Map the prerequisite adapter callbacks into bridge contracts and decide the MIME sizing seam. Audit existing task supervision, mailer hooks, and caller expectations before choosing execution helpers. The Outgoing field is the sole producer-contract addition; Agent selection logic remains unchanged. Begin only after Tasks 0A, 0B, and dependency adoption in Task 1 pass; use their verified dependency APIs and upload-request sizing contract rather than designing against the old sibling branch.

**Tests:** extend `test/zaq/engine/messages/outgoing_test.exs` for default nil plan and unchanged builders; `test/zaq/channels/delivery_error_test.exs` for safe inspection and new stages. Specify contract tests in existing delivery suites before implementing behavior.

**Paths:** old text-only callers, absent optional callbacks, malformed requirements, combined versus split transport, private data exclusion.

**Mocking:** reuse existing bridge/provider doubles and real materialization fixtures. Contract tests must not depend on an uncommitted sibling checkout.

**Reuse:** extend existing Bridge, Outgoing, and DeliveryError. New structs are domain data, not Actions or tools. Their consumers are Channel preparation and execution; they add no side effects or permission authority.

**Docs:** module docs and `docs/services/channels.md`. Recheck `docs/architecture.md` for the orchestration ownership change.

Record decisions before downstream work: precise unresolved/not-applicable limits, operation names mapped to verified SDK contracts, MIME preparation/submission seam and root-promotion body/callback behavior. Do not silently select an approximate MIME size implementation.

Reuse/verification: use the existing owner and tests named above; no parallel transport pipeline, new history store, automatic Action/tool exposure or Agent-selection changes. Scope any new scheduler unit suite to genuinely distinct invariants.
title: [zaq-1lw.2] Define shared file requirements, delivery plan and result contracts
